newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends weaker, support intact.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends weaker, support intact.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures failed to sustain gains and settled slightly below unchanged.
Dealers said losses were led by early fund selling in the second-position May contract, but also noted heavy fund selling in March contract, near the close.
Trade scale-down buying from 10.29 in May was also cited.

Although prices failed to hold earlier gains, March managed to remain above support at 10.10 cents. The market could rally to resistance at 10.40 in March, if the contract fails to take out support in the near term, a trader said. "We couldn't
break through 10.10 and make new lows," he said, noting stops below support. "There is a lot of consolidation here."
Resistance above 10.40 in March is seen at a gap between 10.47 to 10.50 cents.
The spot month closed at 10.15 cents, down 0.02. May ended 0.07 weaker at 10.25, while the back months went out 0.03 to 0.01 lower.
Open interest in the most-active March contract rose 985 lots to 70,462 lots.
